provenance: Original procedural animation inspired by OCTOPO's MISFITZ Gloss special. No reference artwork extracted.
order: Four quadrants; each contains a 4x4 animation ordered left-to-right, top-to-bottom.

channels.r: asymmetric pink contours with directional cutout masks
channels.g: independently authored open yellow strokes and cutouts

integration: Additive effect layer at the existing hammer impact event; original smash components retained. Material uses normal alpha blending.
fans: Procedural radial sectors in the fragment shader; no atlas channel.
